title: Pullback square for a specified finite-free bottom chain map
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X,Z\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $f:X\to Z$ and $a\in\mathbf Z$. Choose derived categories for all schemes in one morphism universe. Let $W\subset T$ be open, and let $A,B$ be bounded-above cochain complexes on $W$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Suppose $A^{a-1}=B^{a-1}=0$, $d_A^a=d_B^a=0$, and $\alpha:A\to B$ has invertible component $\alpha^a$. Fix $e_A:L(W\hookrightarrow T)^*X\cong Q(A)$ and $e_B:L(W\hookrightarrow T)^*Z\cong Q(B)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], with $L(W\hookrightarrow T)^*f\,e_B=e_AQ(\alpha)$. For every $g:T\prime\to T$ and $y\in T\prime$ with $g(y)\in W$, there is an open $V$ containing $y$, complexes $P,Q$ of module sheaves on the localized site over $V$, with $P^{a-1}=Q^{a-1}=0$, $d_P^a=d_Q^a=0$, and a chain map $\beta:P\to Q$ with invertible $\beta^a$, together with isomorphisms $e_P:H^a(Lg^*X)|_V\cong H^a(P)$ and $e_Q:H^a(Lg^*Z)|_V\cong H^a(Q)$ satisfying $H^a(Lg^*f)|_V\,e_Q=e_PH^a(\beta)$.

source.place: K-flat computation and naturality, with 06YD bounded-above flatness, 0D5S composition and 08DW restriction

proof.text: Choose V=g inverse-image W. The hypothesis hy is exactly y∈V. Define F explicitly as tensorPullback of the restricted morphism g.resLE W V (le_refl V), followed by the inverse of Modules.overEquiv V.

Apply bottomFreeChain_pullback_comparison to the bounded-above finite-free complexes and given chart square. Obtain additivity of F and simultaneous homology isomorphisms eP and eQ satisfying the naturality equation for P=F(A), Q=F(B) and β=F(α).

Use Functor.map_isZero F on hAprev and hBprev. The differentials of the termwise images are F.map of the original differentials, hence vanish by hAzero, hBzero and F.map_zero. The degree-a component of β is F.map (α.f a), which is invertible because functors preserve isomorphisms. Assemble these five proved conditions, the membership hy and the comparison equation into the required existential conjunction.

lean.statement:
theorem bottomFreeChain_pullback_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (X Z : schemeDerivedCategory T) (f : X ⟶ Z) (a : ℤ)
    (W : T.Opens)
    (A B : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hAbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (A.X i))
    (hBbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (B.X i))
    (hAfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (A.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (hBfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (B.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (hAprev : IsZero (A.X (a - 1))) (hBprev : IsZero (B.X (a - 1)))
    (hAzero : A.d a (a + 1) = 0) (hBzero : B.d a (a + 1) = 0)
    (α : A ⟶ B) (hα : IsIso (α.f a))
    (eA : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj X ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj A)
    (eB : (derivedPullback W.ι).obj Z ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)
    (hsquare : (derivedPullback W.ι).map f ≫ eB.hom =
      eA.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map α)
    (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T) (y : T') (hy : g.base y ∈ W) :
    ∃ V : T'.Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      ∃ P Q : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ,
        IsZero (P.X (a - 1)) ∧ IsZero (Q.X (a - 1)) ∧
        P.d a (a + 1) = 0 ∧ Q.d a (a + 1) = 0 ∧
        ∃ β : P ⟶ Q, IsIso (β.f a) ∧
          ∃ (eP : ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
              ((derivedPullback g).obj X)).over V ≅ P.homology a)
            (eQ : ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
              ((derivedPullback g).obj Z)).over V ≅ Q.homology a),
            (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).map
                ((derivedPullback g).map f)).over V) ≫ eQ.hom =
                  eP.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap β a
